newsitem.title: USA: Volunteer Capital proposes name change.
newsitem.headline: Volunteer Capital proposes name change.

text.p: The board of directors of Volunteer Capital Corp said on Thursday it approved a proposed charter amendment to change the company's name to J. Alexander's Corp.
The new name would more closely identify the company with its J. Alexander's casual-dining restaurants, it said.

Shareholders will vote on the proposal at a special meeting on February 7. Also subject to shareholder approval is a proposal to change the company's New York Stock Exchange trading symbol to "JAX" to reflect the name change.
Volunteer Capital Corp currently trades on the NYSE under the symbol "VCC".
